_note: Version manifest polled by pull-agent.py (outbound-only). desired_version is the version lanes should run. Bundle URLs must be curl-verifiable; sha256 must match or the lane refuses the bundle.

v1.0.0.notes: First versioned node bundle: the lane software as deployed by bootstrap.sh (heartbeat, attestation chain, merge, object-store client).

v1.1.0.notes: Fused lane software: the node bundle plus the cluster middleware (pull-agent, its systemd unit) and a real self-test. The fused bootstrap births a cluster citizen in one paste; pull-agent applies this layout itself (node/ + pull-agent/ + unit, previous kept for rollback).
